description.value: The Saigonville is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant on East Hastings Street led by Chef Kevin Nguyen, who blends classic Saigon flavours with Western culinary techniques in dishes like truffle crab spring rolls, grilled La Lot beef, and house-made bánh khọt. Open since 2024, it has collected several local food awards including recognition from Vancouver Foodster and the Canadian Choice Award. Catering and online ordering for pickup or delivery are available in addition to dine-in service.
